reason: 2 assertion(s) still do not test what their SPEC says after 2 rounds

findings.text: SPEC-1's assertion establishes only part of the requirement: P2 shows fast-one completed before the pipeline timed out, which is consistent with the watchdog firing while the engine is idle, but the assertion does not directly verify the engine's dispatch state at the moment of timeout — it passes equally if another stage was running when the watchdog fired, leaving the "fires even when idle between dispatches" sub-requirement only indirectly established.

SPEC-3's assertion establishes only part of the requirement: The assertion reads _post_sleep_status live from the state file and checks sentinel absence, which are the correct checks, but whether the prerequisite sleep past max_run_s=4s occurs before these reads is not visible in the assertion text; without that sleep, absent sentinel proves only that the watchdog has not fired yet, not that it was reaped, so the requirement's "sleep past max_run_s then re-read" clause is not established by the assertion alone.
